topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Well, well, if it ain't the classic tale of the road taken and the one left behind. Heard about your friend pulling up stakes, didn't I? Funny how news like that rolls in, often with a silver lining. People come and go, sure as the rain washes the city, but it's the ones who leave that sometimes make you appreciate the storm. Might be tough swallowing that pill now, but there's a fresh breeze in every farewell, you mark my words. Could be just the push you needed. The city has a way of trapping you in its节奏, but every once in a while, it lets you breathe. Maybe this is your moment.
